lid.d: headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim

lido.d: a recreational facility including a swimming pool for water sports

lidocaine.d: a local anesthetic (trade names Lidocaine and Xylocaine) used topically on the skin and mucous membranes

lidded.d: having or covered with a lid or lids; often used in combination

lidar.d: a measuring system that detects and locates objects on the same principle as radar but uses light from a laser; a potential technology for detecting air turbulence that can affect aircraft
